answer: Cap the supply of new identity slots: each epoch the network sells only a fixed handful, like rare pearl berths on a crowded terrace, through a sealed second-price auction whose proceeds are burned. A farm bidding for hundreds of slots just drives up the clearing price it pays itself, while honest newcomers need only one. Slots lapse after thirty epochs unless renewed by peer-graded work, so a hoard of idle clones fades like opal left in the dark.
